connector.name: Sendblue Browser MCP
connector.registryDescription: Drive a stealth-patched Chromium daemon: navigate, screenshot, eval JS, attach over CDP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sendblue-browser-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sendblue-api account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
